thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1: AUTH_SIGNING_VALIDATION_FAILED — page fired to #team-auth (service: auth-service). PD link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD12345

sam (oncall-auth): acked — looking now. assigning self.

sam (oncall-auth): quick summary from alert: huge spike of 401s starting ~2026-03-14T09:42:00Z, auth-validate returning 'invalid_token' / 'kid not found' errors. Graphs show ~5% of requests failing at peak.

priya (eng-runtime): seeing lots of this in auth-validate logs: `JWT validation failed: kid "a3b2" not found in JWKS` across multiple pods. Also seeing repeated JWKS fetch failures (502/504) from keys service.

sam (oncall-auth): I can reproduce by curling the JWKS endpoint — getting 502 intermittently:
```bash
curl -i https://keys.internal.redwood/.well-known/jwks.json
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json
{ "error": "upstream connect error or timeout" }
```

marta (product-support): customer impact: preliminary query shows 12 customers with elevated auth errors; highest impact on token-refresh flows (mobile + web). Logged a support ticket for ACME (ticket #SUP-8321). ETA for customer-facing note?

carlos (ops): checking k8s secrets and recent deploys — there was a key rotation rollout at 09:34 UTC (deploy auth-key-rotation v2 -> PR #7890). Noticed the new jwks secret only propagates to some clusters; others still request old keys causing mismatch.

priya (eng-runtime): logs indicate auth-validator pods that got the new secret are signing with new kid=a3b2 while some validators are still consulting an old cached JWKS or old signer. That explains kid mismatch on validation path.

alex (alex.chen): probable root: key rotation job updated signing keys but cache invalidation/fanout to validators failed — there's a race where validators request JWKS and hit a flaky keys-service endpoint returning 502, causing them to continue using cached (or no) keys.

sam (oncall-auth): mitigation plan: 1) stop further rotations (disable rotation job), 2) restore last-known-good JWKS to cluster-wide secret, 3) restart auth-validator pods to pick up keys, 4) monitor 401 rate.

carlos (ops): ready to restore. command I'll run (in prod):
```bash
# restore jwks secret to previous payload (from vault backup)
kubectl -n prod set secret auth-jwks --from-file=jwks=/secrets/backups/jwks-2026-03-14.json
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/auth-validator
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/auth-validator --timeout=120s
```

sam (oncall-auth): doing the restore now. will tail logs.

sam (oncall-auth): (09:55) restored secret + restarted. auth-validator pods coming up. tail shows `loaded jwks keys: 3 entries, primary kid=a1f9`

priya (eng-runtime): early signal: 401 spike dropping. graphs: 401s from 5% -> 0.6% in ~2m. latency normal.

sam (oncall-auth): (10:00) paging PD incident to resolved? not yet — keeping open for 30m of stable. marking mitigation: restored previous jwks, paused rotation job.

jordan (sre-lead): good work. escalate checklist: open follow-up incident ticket, collect deployment timeline, logs, and secrets-change audit. assign postmortem to priya + sam, include ops and security. Also schedule 1:1 with key-rotation PR author.

marta (product-support): drafting customer communication for affected accounts, will send to SRE for review.

alex (alex.chen): notes for postmortem: investigate JWKS fanout reliability, add canary to rotation job, fail-fast if JWKS fetch returns 5xx, and add a rollout gating step to ensure all validators confirm key pull before switching primary signing key.

sam (oncall-auth): handoff: I'll keep monitoring until 10:15 UTC, then hand to jordan (sre-lead) for the next 2 hours. leaving brief in ops-runbook.

jordan (sre-lead): taking over at 10:15. summary for handoff: root cause likely incomplete propagation of key rotation + transient JWKS service errors -> kid mismatch -> validation failures. Mitigation applied: restored previous JWKS secret and paused rotation. Customer impact: ~12 customers, token-refresh flows affected, peak 5% failure rate, now returning to baseline. Next: postmortem + improved rotation gating.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: mitigation_in_progress -> monitoring. PD incident PD12345 updated.

sam (oncall-auth): :white_check_mark: closing my active ack, will remain subscribed for follow-ups.

jordan (sre-lead): will own the follow-up and postmortem. assigning to priya + sam + ops. follow-up ticket created: INC-2026-032.

marta (product-support): posting customer note draft to #customer-notifications for review.

alex (alex.chen): adding one action item: add explicit end-to-end test in deploy pipeline that verifies JWKS fetch and validator acceptance during rotation.

sam (oncall-auth): final check at 10:20: health stable, 401s at baseline. closing thread after monitoring window.
